> "The project was officially incorporated as a gGmbH (a German form of non-profit LLC) in 2021 but lost its non-profit status when Germany removed software projects from eligibility. In 2025, the team began the process of moving the project to a new foundation, and began implementing community governance.
>
>  Mastodon, Inc.
> Mastodon, Inc. (EIN 92-3333630) is a 501(c)(3) non-profit entity in the United States that supports the growth and operational capabilities of Mastodon, including being able to receive tax-deductible U.S. donations and in-kind support. 
>
